workflowRole.function: clone an authorized speaker voice from local reference audio

conditions: retain the MIT notice when distributing the software
comply with Apache-2.0 when redistributing model materials

transitiveDependencies.auditStatus: sufficient for current local output use; full SBOM pending before runtime redistribution
transitiveDependencies.distributionAction: do not publish the packaged runtime until dependency notices and licenses are collected

cost.storage: about 2.51 GB model download plus runtime cache
cost.freeConclusion: no software or API fee in the tested local route; total operating cost is not zero

access.account: public Hugging Face download did not require a paid plan
access.hardware: Apple Silicon; tested on M2 Pro with 16 GB unified memory
access.region: no project-specific restriction identified in the cited licenses
access.organizationLimits: none stated by Apache-2.0 and MIT

rightsAndPrivacy.biometricData: voice reference remains local but is sensitive personal data
rightsAndPrivacy.retention: keep references and outputs outside Git and delete according to the identity record
rightsAndPrivacy.outputRightsBoundary: software licenses do not grant permission to impersonate or use an unauthorized voice
rightsAndPrivacy.aiLabeling: preserve provenance and apply current platform and applicable AI-generated-content labeling rules before publication

stability.maturity: new model; usable only with pinned revision and runtime in the tested scope
stability.reproducibility: seed 42 repeated with an identical WAV SHA-256 under the pinned environment
knownFailureModes: word substitutions can occur across seeds
long-form emotion and prosody are not validated
high memory pressure on a 16 GB Mac
stability.vendorLockIn: low for WAV output; medium for the MLX-specific runtime

evidence.scope: one 10.4-second reference and one 7.008-second Chinese sentence
evidence.hardware: Apple M2 Pro, 16 GB unified memory

recommendation.allowedRole: authorized short local voice sample; seed 42 is the accepted preset for the tested reference
recommendation.blockedRole: unreviewed long-form/emotional narration and any unauthorized voice
recommendation.reason: user accepted the sample, ASR matched, and the run was local and reproducible
recheckTriggers: license, platform, privacy, or labeling rule changes
